lines.en: label sanadorm50:
I knock on Sana’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Sana 的门，等她来应门。

lines.en: I can hear what sounds like loud gunfire from inside of the room so either Sana is playing a video game or in grave danger right now.
lines.zh: 我听见房间里传来像是激烈枪声的动静，所以 Sana 要么在打游戏，要么正处于极度危险之中。

lines.en: I knock again to confirm that Sana is not involved in a real gunfight.
lines.zh: 我又敲了一次，以确认 Sana 没有卷入真正的枪战。

lines.en: : One...second...
lines.zh: : 等……等一下……

lines.en: The gunfire ceases after several seconds and Sana either pauses her game or dies.
lines.zh: 几秒后枪声停了，Sana 要么暂停了游戏，要么死了。

lines.en: I guess I won’t know the real answer until she lets me in.
lines.zh: 我想，在她放我进去之前，我是不会知道真正答案的。

lines.en: Which she wouldn’t be able to do if she was dead.
lines.zh: 而如果她死了，她也就没法放我进去了。

lines.en: : Okay...you can come in now...
lines.zh: : 好……你现在可以进来了……

lines.en: scene black
As it turns out, Sana has either won the gunfight or-
lines.zh: 结果看来，Sana 要么赢了那场枪战，要么——

lines.en: Actually, for the sake of moving things along, I’m going to assume there was no gunfight at all and that it really was just a video game.
lines.zh: 其实，为了让事情继续推进，我打算假定根本没有什么枪战，那真的只是一款电子游戏。

lines.en: Some might say this is a fair assumption considering Sana has been known to waste away her time with those.
lines.zh: 考虑到 Sana 一向喜欢把时间浪费在那种东西上，有人会说这是个合理的假设。

lines.en: However, that doesn’t mean she isn’t secretly hiding an alternate life as a criminal or something along those lines.
lines.zh: 但这并不代表她没有偷偷藏着一层罪犯之类的另类人生。

lines.en: In fact, there are countless situations where people will go on killing sprees only to have all of the people who knew them while they {i}weren’t{/i} killing people proclaim how normal said killer was.
lines.zh: 事实上，有无数这样的例子：某人疯狂杀人之后，所有在他{i}不{/i}杀人的时候认识他的人，都会站出来说这个杀手有多正常。

lines.en: I could very well be one of those people.
lines.zh: 我很有可能就是那种人之一。

lines.en: The normal ones, I mean.
lines.zh: 我是指，正常人那部分。

lines.en: I’d never hurt a fly.
lines.zh: 我连一只苍蝇都不会伤害。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops1
: Um...hey...
It appears that there may have been a gunfight after all, as Sana is nowhere to be found.
lines.zh: 看来可能真的发生过枪战，因为 Sana 不见踪影。

lines.en: : Sorry. I think I have the wrong room.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我想我走错房间了。

lines.en: : Because my hair isn’t covering my eyes?...
lines.zh: : 因为我的头发没挡住眼睛？……

lines.en: : ...Sana?
lines.zh: : ……Sana？

lines.en: : Sensei...you’ve seen me like this before...
lines.zh: : Sensei……你以前见过我这副样子的……

lines.en: : Your...fake surprise is getting a little old.
lines.zh: : 你那副……假装惊讶的样子，已经有点看腻了。

lines.en: : It’s not fake. I was actually just inner monologuing about how you lost in a gunfight.
lines.zh: : 不是假装的。我刚刚在内心里独白，猜你是输在了枪战里。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops2
: Gunfight?...
: Oh, you must be talking about the game I was playing.
lines.zh: : 哦，你说的一定是我刚在玩的那个游戏。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops3
: I’m...still not great at games like that...so I was spending the night practicing so...I don’t look really bad the next time I play with Rin...
lines.zh: : 我……那种游戏还是玩得不太好……所以今晚一直在练，这样……下次和 Rin 一起玩的时候就不会太丢人……

lines.en: : Well I’m glad to see that you’re trying to improve yourself in ways beyond just speaking, but I think there might be better areas to improve in than how well you can shoot virtual stuff.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很高兴看到你在说话之外也试着提升自己，不过我觉得，比起射虚拟的东西有多准，还有更值得提升的方面。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops4
: Probably. But...I don’t think I’d have as much fun using my free time on things like that...
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。不过……我觉得把空闲时间花在那种事上，不会有这么开心……

lines.en: : Besides, for all you know...you could really like stuff like that too, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 而且，说不定……你也真的很喜欢这种东西呢，Sensei。

lines.en: : What if...you’re secretly really good at shooters and you just...don’t know it yet?
lines.zh: : 万一……你其实很擅长射击游戏，只是……自己还不知道呢？

lines.en: : That’s not even something I’d {i}want{/i} to be good at.
lines.zh: : 那根本不是我{i}想要{/i}擅长的东西。

lines.en: : Why not? Don’t you want to impress girls?
lines.zh: : 为什么不想？你不想让女孩子对你刮目相看吗？

lines.en: : Since when is that a thing girls are impressed by?
lines.zh: : 从什么时候开始，女孩子会对这种事刮目相看了？

lines.en: : I know {i}I’d{/i} be impressed. Rin too.
lines.zh: : 反正{i}我会{/i}。Rin 也会。

lines.en: : And Molly. And probably even Ami and Ayane.
lines.zh: : 还有 Molly。大概连 Ami 和 Ayane 也是。

lines.en: : Though...I don’t think it’s really possible for you to be any cooler in their books than you already are.
lines.zh: : 不过……我觉得在她们心里，你也不可能比现在更有魅力了。

lines.en: : But...what I’m saying is...that it’s nice finding people who are...good at the things you’re interested in...
lines.zh: : 但……我想说的是……能找到和你有共同爱好、而且又擅长的人，是件很好的事……

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops5
: And...also that I could maybe use someone to practice against since...the AI in this game isn’t very good...
lines.zh: : 还有……我也可能需要一个陪我练习的人，因为……这游戏里的 AI 不太行……

lines.en: : Ahh. So it was all just one big ploy to get me to play with you.
lines.zh: : 啊。所以这一切都是个让我陪你玩的大阴谋。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops6
: Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。

lines.en: : Are you actually winking at me right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是真的在对我眨眼吗？

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops7
: I’ve winked at you before, too...you just weren’t able to see it.
lines.zh: : 我以前也对你眨过眼……只是你看不见而已。

lines.en: : You know, I’ve been fortunate...or {i}unfortunate{/i} based on how you look at things a very fair amount of times over the last...school year-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，在上个……学年里，我有过相当多次幸运——或者按你怎么看，{i}不幸{/i}——的经历——

lines.en: : But I think that this plot twist might be the most surprising one yet.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得，这次的剧情转折可能是迄今为止最让人意外的。

lines.en: : Heheh...yeah...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……是啊……

lines.en: : It’s kind of hard to believe with how I started out...huh?
lines.zh: : 想想我一开始的样子，还挺难相信的……呢？

lines.en: : I mean, you’re not {i}that{/i} different from how you started out.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你跟一开始相比也没变{i}多少{/i}。

lines.en: : You just talk a little more and have an extra eye now.
lines.zh: : 只是话多了一点，还多了一只眼睛。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops8
: Just...for tonight...
lines.zh: : 只是……仅限今晚……

lines.en: : I still like my hair better the other way...I just...also know it can be a bit of a handicap for games that require your full attention.
lines.zh: : 我还是更喜欢头发挡着的那个样子……只是……我也知道，在需要全神贯注的游戏里，它会有点碍事。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops9
: But...yeah...
: I’m...definitely not the same person I was when we met all that...
lines.zh: : 我……肯定已经不是我们刚认识时的那个人了，在那段……

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops10
: ...time ago?
lines.zh: : ……很久以前？

lines.en: : How...
lines.zh: : 有多……

lines.en: : How long have we known each other again?...
lines.zh: : 我们认识多久了来着？……

lines.en: : Because...the[school] year isn’t even halfway over and...
lines.zh: : 因为……[school] 学年连一半都还没过完，而且……

lines.en: I pause for a moment to see where this train of thought takes Sana.
lines.zh: 我停顿了一下，想看看 Sana 这串思绪会通往哪里。

lines.en: Of course, for me, it’s been much longer than just half a[school] year.
lines.zh: 当然，对我来说，远不止半个 [school] 学年那么久。

lines.en: Counting the other iterations of myself (Which apparently sucked even more than me for the most part), {i}I’ve{/i} likely gone through this hundreds, if not thousands of times.
lines.zh: 算上我的其他那些版本（据说大部分比我还差劲），{i}我{/i}大概已经经历过几百次，甚至几千次了。

lines.en: How interesting would things be if someone like her caught onto what’s happening as well?
lines.zh: 要是像她这样的人也察觉到正在发生什么，事情会变得多有意思？

lines.en: That it’s been longer than half a[school] year.
lines.zh: : 察觉到这一切远不止半个 [school] 学年。

lines.en: That we’ve crammed three nearly full ones into the space of one and, if things go according to plan, are going to cram many, many more.
lines.zh: : 察觉到我们把三段几乎完整的学年塞进了一段的时间里，而且如果一切按计划进行，还会塞进更多、更多。

lines.en: I say, as if I actually have a plan.
lines.zh: 我这么说，好像我真有什么计划似的。

lines.en: If I had a plan, I wouldn’t be simply waiting to see where the train stops.
lines.zh: 如果我有计划，我就不会只是等着看这列火车停在哪儿。

lines.en: I’d be helping her get on board or...selling her a ticket or...
lines.zh: 我会在帮她上车，或者……卖给她一张票，或者……

lines.en: Doing anything but watching.
lines.zh: 做任何事都好过只是看着。

lines.en: Watching and waiting for her to uncover the secrets of the universe while both myself and Maya have no idea what those secrets even are.
lines.zh: 看着，等着她去揭开宇宙的秘密，而我和 Maya 根本连那些秘密是什么都不知道。

lines.en: I think.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: Frankly, she might know and is just deciding against telling me about it.
lines.zh: 说实话，她可能知道，只是决定不告诉我。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops11
: It’s funny how time can slip away from us, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 时间是多么容易从我们指缝间溜走啊，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s almost like-
lines.zh: : 是啊。就好像——

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops12
: It’s almost like one minute...you’re doing one thing...and the next minute...you...don’t even remember what that thing was.
lines.zh: : 就好像前一分钟……你还在做一件事……下一分钟……你……连那件事是什么都不记得了。

lines.en: How long have we been playing this for?
lines.zh: 我们这局打了多久了？

lines.en: And, better question, how did Sana manage to convince me to play a video game in the first place?
lines.zh: 还有个更好的问题：Sana 到底是怎么说服我打电子游戏的？

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops13
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Are you...upset at me for...killing you so many times?
lines.zh: : 你……因为我把你杀了那么多次……在生我的气吗？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 不算是。

lines.en: : I just think I’m feeling the effects of that whole “time slipping away” thing as we speak.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，我现在正体会着那种“时间溜走”的感觉。

lines.en: : That tends to happen to me when I play games as well...
lines.zh: : 我打游戏的时候也经常这样……

lines.en: : But it’s not like it doesn’t happen in...different ways, too.
lines.zh: : 不过它也确实会……以不同的方式发生。

lines.en: : Is this you admitting that you’re finally in love with me?
lines.zh: : 这是不是意味着你终于承认爱上我了？

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops14
: Wh...What?...No...of course not....
lines.zh: : 什……什么？……不……当然不是……

lines.en: : It’s true that we’re...a lot closer now than before, but...it’s not anything like that....
lines.zh: : 我们确实……比以前亲近多了，可是……不是那种……

lines.en: : I know that. I was just messing around.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我只是开个玩笑。

lines.en: Damn it.
lines.zh: 该死。

lines.en: : Though, it’s hard to ever really recall a time where we’ve been this close before.
lines.zh: : 不过，我也确实想不起来我们以前有过这么亲近的时候。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops15
: That’s...closer to what I was getting at...
lines.zh: : 这……更接近我想说的……

lines.en: : When we first met {s}so, so long ago{/s} at the beginning of the[school] year, I never would have imagined...sitting on my bed in the dark with you...
lines.zh: : 在{s}很久很久{/s}以前、[school] 学年刚开始的时候我们初次相遇，我绝不会想到……有一天会和你一起在黑暗里坐在我的床上……

lines.en: : But now...I can do it without even feeling a little uncomfortable...
lines.zh: : 可现在……我甚至一点都不觉得别扭了……

lines.en: : You should feel at least {i}slightly{/i} uncomfortable, I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你至少该有{i}一点点{/i}别扭才对。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops16
: Why is that?
lines.zh: : 为什么呢？

lines.en: : Because you’re my teacher and I’m your student?
lines.zh: : 因为你是我的老师，我是你的学生？

lines.en: : That’s a very roundabout way of putting it and doesn’t really touch on the dramatic disparity between our ages and sizes.
lines.zh: : 这说法可真绕，而且根本没触及我们年龄和体型之间巨大的差距。

lines.en: : Aren’t we friends before that, though?
lines.zh: : 不过在那之前，我们不是朋友吗？

lines.en: : Doesn’t that take priority?
lines.zh: : 朋友不是应该更重要吗？

lines.en: I try my best to play whatever game the two of us are playing, but...as expected, I’m not very good.
lines.zh: 我尽力去玩我们两个正在玩的那个游戏，但……不出所料，我玩得很烂。

lines.en: I {i}am{/i} doing much better than I imagined I would with zero experience, though.
lines.zh: 不过在毫无经验的情况下，我打得比想象中好多了。

lines.en: And...I’m already somehow familiar with what all of the buttons do.
lines.zh: 而且……我不知怎么的，已经对每个按键的作用都很熟悉了。

lines.en: Kind of like I’m coasting off of muscle memory despite a complete lack of {i}mental{/i} memory.
lines.zh: 有点像是在完全没有{i}记忆{/i}的情况下，靠着肌肉记忆在滑行。

lines.en: : I guess the whole friendship thing takes priority.
lines.zh: : 我想，朋友这件事确实更重要。

lines.en: : I mean, it doesn’t really matter to me either way.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，其实怎样都无所谓。

lines.en: : To be completely honest, I don’t really view {i}any{/i} of you girls as friends.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我并没有真的把{i}你们这些女孩{/i}当成朋友。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops17
: You...don’t?
lines.zh: : 你……不把我们当朋友？

lines.en: : Not really. No.
lines.zh: : 不算是。是的。

lines.en: : Then...what do you view us as?...
lines.zh: : 那……你把我们当成什么？……

lines.en: : Hm.
: That’s a complicated question.
lines.zh: : 这是个很复杂的问题。

lines.en: : I don’t mind if there’s a...complicated answer...
lines.zh: : 就算答案……很复杂，我也不介意……

lines.en: : What about an answer so simple that it just {i}seems{/i} complicated?
lines.zh: : 那如果答案简单到反而{i}显得{/i}复杂呢？

lines.en: : I...don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我……不知道……

lines.en: : I just...really thought we were friends...this whole time...
lines.zh: : 我只是……一直真的以为我们是朋友……

lines.en: : I’m going to kill you if you don’t pay attention.
lines.zh: : 你要是不专心，我可要杀你了。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops18
: What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: : In the game.
lines.zh: : 在游戏里。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops19
: O-Oh...yeah...sorry...
: There’s not really any one word I’d use to describe the relationship I have with all of you girls.
lines.zh: : 我实在找不到一个词，能用来形容我和你们这些女孩之间的关系。

lines.en: : You’re not friends or lovers or family or any other blanket term I can just toss all of you under.
lines.zh: : 你们不是朋友，不是恋人，也不是家人，不是任何一个我能把你们统统塞进去的笼统称呼。

lines.en: : I treat every one of you differently and wouldn’t feel right simply calling you one thing or another.
lines.zh: : 我对你们每个人的态度都不一样，随便给你们安一个称呼，我觉得不对。

lines.en: : We can be friendly and not be friends. Just like we can be intimate and not be lovers.
lines.zh: : 我们可以很亲近，却不是朋友。就像我们可以很亲密，却不是恋人。

lines.en: : I...don’t really want-
lines.zh: : 我……其实不想——

lines.en: : But at the end of the day, I’m just me and you’re just you. And Ayane is just Ayane and Ami is just Ami.
lines.zh: : 但归根结底，我就是我，你就是你。Ayane 就是 Ayane，Ami 就是 Ami。

lines.en: : Labels are dumb.
lines.zh: : 标签这种东西很蠢。

lines.en: : So...am I still allowed to call you my friend?
lines.zh: : 那……我还可以叫你朋友吗？

lines.en: : Call me whatever you want. I don’t care.
lines.zh: : 你想怎么称呼我都行。我不在乎。

lines.en: : Just don’t ask me how I see you, because it’s not a question that’s easy for me to answer.
lines.zh: : 只是别问我怎么看你，因为这个问题我不好回答。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops20
: That’s fine...
lines.zh: : 那也没关系……

lines.en: : There are plenty of questions I find hard to answer, after all...and you’ve never pushed me to actually answer any of them...
lines.zh: : 毕竟我也有很多难以回答的问题……而你也从来没有逼我回答过……

lines.en: : That’s because your life is your life and your secrets are your secrets.
lines.zh: : 那是因为你的人生是你的人生，你的秘密是你的秘密。

lines.en: : I don’t need to know things you don’t want me to know.
lines.zh: : 你不想让我知道的事，我不需要知道。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops21
: But in the event that you ever want to tell me-
lines.zh: : 但如果有一天你想告诉我——

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Sana?
lines.zh: : Sana？

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops22
: It’s been several years since my brother died now.
lines.zh: : 我哥哥去世到现在，已经好几年了。

lines.en: : But, somehow, it feels a lot longer.
lines.zh: : 可不知怎么的，感觉还要久得多。

lines.en: : I keep a lock of his hair in a box on the table behind you.
lines.zh: : 我把他的一缕头发收在你身后桌子上的盒子里。

lines.en: : My mom has one too.
lines.zh: : 我妈妈也有一个。

lines.en: : She used to smell it before going to bed every night...and then cry into her pillow thinking I couldn’t hear her from down the hall.
lines.zh: : 她以前每天晚上睡前都要闻一闻……然后把脸埋进枕头里哭，以为隔着走廊我听不见。

lines.en: : I did.
lines.zh: : 我听见了。

lines.en: : I always did.
lines.zh: : 我一直都听得见。

lines.en: : And for a long time, that would make me cry too.
lines.zh: : 有很长一段时间，那也会让我跟着哭。

lines.en: : But now, I can barely even open the box anymore because it just reminds me of what actually happened to him.
lines.zh: : 可现在，我几乎连那个盒子都打不开了，因为它只会让我想起他真正的遭遇。

lines.en: : You should ask me what happened to him.
lines.zh: : 你应该问问他发生了什么。

lines.en: : What are you-
lines.zh: : 你在说什——

lines.en: : Making my secrets your secrets.
lines.zh: : 把我的秘密变成你的秘密。

lines.en: : Telling you the things I want you to know before I change my mind and don’t want you to know them.
lines.zh: : 在我改主意、不想让你知道之前，把我想让你知道的事告诉你。

lines.en: : I don’t want to just be {i}Sana{/i} to you anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不想再只是你眼里的 {i}Sana{/i} 了。

lines.en: : I want to be your friend.
lines.zh: : 我想成为你的朋友。

lines.en: : Having you just see me as {i}me{/i}...isn't enough to make me feel the way I want to feel.
lines.zh: : 你只是把我当成{i}我{/i}……还不足以让我有我想要的感觉。

lines.en: : I don’t really know how you want to feel, but I can’t just ask you what happened when-
lines.zh: : 我不太清楚你想要什么感觉，可我总不能就这么问你发生了什么——

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops23
: I'll just tell you, then.
lines.zh: : 那我就直接告诉你吧。

lines.en: : He was killed.
lines.zh: : 他被人杀了。

lines.en: : Stabbed to death on his way home from a friend’s house one night.
lines.zh: : 一天晚上，他在从朋友家回来的路上被捅死了。

lines.en: : He was younger than I am now when it happened.
lines.zh: : 事情发生的时候，他比现在的我还小。

lines.en: : We never even found out who did it.
lines.zh: : 我们甚至一直没查出是谁干的。

lines.en: : Now...{i}that’s{/i} what I think of every time I open the box.
lines.zh: : 现在……每次打开那个盒子，我想到的就是{i}这个{/i}。

lines.en: : That time...really does slip away faster than we expect it to...
lines.zh: : 时间……确实比我们预想的溜得更快……

lines.en: : But no amount of time can fix certain things once they break beyond recognition.
lines.zh: : 可有些东西一旦碎得面目全非，再多的时间也修不好。

lines.en: : So you’re forced to let it slip even more.
lines.zh: : 所以你只能任由它溜得更多。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops24
: He used to play games like this, you know. The same way we are now.
lines.zh: : 他以前也玩这种游戏，你知道吗。就像我们现在这样。

lines.en: : And whenever he got me to play with him, he’d always take it easy on me.
lines.zh: : 每次他拉我一起玩的时候，总会让着我。

lines.en: : So...I’ve been taking it easy on you tonight. Trying to set the example he made for me.
lines.zh: : 所以……今晚我也一直在让着你。想学着他的样子做个榜样。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : I’m still going to kill you if you don’t pay attention.
lines.zh: : 你要是不专心，我还是会杀你的。

lines.en: scene sanasnotacyclops25
I do what I do best and ignore it all.
lines.zh: 我做我最擅长的事：把这一切都无视掉。

lines.en: But, in my defense, that’s what anyone would do in this situation.
lines.zh: 不过说句公道话，这种情况下谁都会这么做。

lines.en: Isn’t it?
lines.zh: 不是吗？

lines.en: Who picks a time like this to come out and admit something as tragic as that?
lines.zh: 谁会挑这种时候，把那么悲惨的事说出来？

lines.en: I guess it’s possible that she’s been wanting me to ask for a while...
lines.zh: 我想，她可能早就想让我开口问了……

lines.en: And I guess it’s also possible that she was desperate for me to know this side of her.
lines.zh: 而且我觉得，她也可能是迫切地想让我认识她这一面。

lines.en: Because, as she said, she {i}wants{/i} to be seen as something more than just herself.
lines.zh: 因为就像她说的，她{i}希望{/i}被看到的，不只是她自己。

lines.en: But to think that none of this would have happened if I’d just given her what she wanted from the start instead of being desperate to hear the sound of my own voice.
lines.zh: 可想想看，如果我从一开始就给了她想要的东西，而不是急着听自己说话的声音，这一切根本就不会发生。

lines.en: She’s crying because of me.
lines.zh: 她是因为我而哭的。

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不。

lines.en: She’s not crying because of me.
lines.zh: 她不是因为我而哭的。

lines.en: She’s crying because she’s subjected herself to a barrage of unhappy memories in exchange for momentary sympathy and a need to be {i}seen.{/i}
lines.zh: 她哭，是因为她让自己承受了一连串痛苦回忆的轰炸，只为换来片刻的同情，以及{i}被看见{/i}的渴望。

lines.en: But I already saw her.
lines.zh: 可我早就看见她了。

lines.en: And I’ll continue to see her each and every day.
lines.zh: 而且我会日复一日地继续看见她。

lines.en: I just happen to know a little more now.
lines.zh: 只是现在我碰巧多知道了一点。

lines.en: I know a little more about a thing I didn’t want to know in the first place.
lines.zh: 我多知道了一点我本来根本不想知道的事。

lines.en: And now {i}I{/i} have to adapt.
lines.zh: 而现在，{i}我{/i}必须去适应。

lines.en: : Thank you for telling me that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你告诉我这些。

lines.en: And I thank her anyway.
lines.zh: 可我还是谢了她。

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: Why must my mouth once again betray the device that directs it?
lines.zh: 为什么我的嘴总要再一次背叛那个指挥它的东西？

lines.en: Why must I act in opposition to myself when all I {i}really{/i} want is to remove her clothes and help her forget the only way I know how?
lines.zh: 为什么我{i}明明{/i}只想脱掉她的衣服、用我唯一会的方式帮她忘掉一切，却非要做出与自己相反的举动？

lines.en: scene black
Everything goes dark.
lines.zh: 一切都陷入黑暗。

lines.en: For you, at least.
lines.zh: 至少对你来说是这样。

lines.en: I can still see everything.
lines.zh: 我还能看见一切。

lines.en: I just don’t want you to see anymore.
lines.zh: 我只是不想让你再看了。

lines.en: Not until the two of us return to normal.
lines.zh: 直到我们两个恢复正常为止。

lines.en: Not until what is hers is no longer mine.
lines.zh: 直到属于她的东西不再属于我。

lines.en: {i}You sit in silence and kill each other for the next hour!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你们沉默地坐着，又互相厮杀了整整一个小时！{/i}
